summary_md: **Jian Yang ([@jian_yang96](https://x.com/jian_yang96/status/2115784219842752721))** introduces **IQuest-Q1**, an open-weight MoE foundation model for coding and agentic CLI work trained with human-supervised recursive self-improvement, with a [report](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.30949), [blog](https://iquestlab.github.io/), [weights](https://huggingface.co/IQuestLab/IQuest-Q1) and [code](https://github.com/IQuestLab/IQuest-Q1).

Abstract
We presentIQuest-Q1,a sparseMixture-of-Experts (MoE)agenticfoundation model with
320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage
process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and μP with
a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a
wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training,
expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending
the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-
specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training
signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines
different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among
their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding
and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community
researchand development.
